scenario: [LIMP.3.3.4]: a member of `math` is reached only through an import of it, and its name is not a reserved word. A file with no import calls `sin(s.v)` in a `where`, and the compiler rejects it as it rejects any call to a name nothing resolves, DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_FUNCTION.
